crossRefs.note: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with his headband over his eyes.
Tamar put ashes on her head, and tore her garment of various colors that was on her; and she laid her hand on her head…
He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.
Daughter of my people, clothe yourself with sackcloth, and wallow in ashes! Mourn, as for an only son, most bitter…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He hurried, and took the headband away from his eyes; and the king of Israel recognized that he was one of the prophets.
translations.bsb: Then the prophet quickly removed the bandage from his eyes, and the king of Israel recognized him as one of the prophets.
translations.kjv: And he hasted, and took the ashes away from his face; and the king of Israel discerned him that he was of the prophets.
translations.asv: And he hasted, and took the headband away from his eyes; and the king of israel discerned him that he was of the prophets.
